note: CM_CD86p: activated classical monocytes — right cluster (CD86+); the CD86-low cluster on the left is excluded. CD86 is bimodal — boundary at the valley between the CD86- and CD86+ peaks. SSC (y) is a context/display axis (no SSC-based call). Naming caveat: 'CM' here = 'Classical Monocyte', not 'Central Memory'.
tips: Activation readout for classical monocytes. CM_CD86p: CD86+. Naming caveat: the prefix `CM` here stands for 'Classical Monocyte' — not 'Central Memory' as in T-cell panels of other cohorts. In-panel co-marker prior: HLA-DR (Comp-BV510-A) is expressed on all monocytes and is typically further up-regulated with CD86 on activated/inflammatory monocytes — complementary activation readout.
